title: How are emotions represented in large language models? A study with Gemma 4 31B
description: A replication and extension of Anthropic's emotion-vectors result on Gemma 4 31B, carried out as a CAMBRIA capstone (Cambridge Boston Alignment Initiative). The base model's biggest emotion axis matches human valence ratings at 0.83 with no human labels in the sorting; instruction tuning demotes that axis to third place, beneath a larger axis we could not identify; and reading the vectors token by token tracks a story's emotional turns better than chance. The interactive write-up is at https://antonio-tresol.github.io/gemma4-emotion-vectors/ and every story corpus, activation and scored output is public on Hugging Face.
